title: Understanding $$\tan(x)$$
text: Consider the ratio $$\tan(x)=\frac{\sin(x)}{\cos(x)}.$$ What happens to this fraction when the denominator is zero?

title: Graph the function
text: Look at the behavior of the graph as $$x$$ approaches $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$. The graph does not approach any specific value, rather it has a vertical asymptote.\n##figure1.gif##

title: Check the endpoints and the behavior in between
text: A domain can only include points where the function actually produces a real number output. Since $$\cos\left(\pm\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=0, $$ the tangent is undefined there, so those points cannot be part of the domain.
